title: Session launch setting scope
contract: Launch settings apply to Session clips, not Arrangement timeline clips. Session Clip View exposes them; multi-selection supports editing launch settings together. Shared panel/grid selection belongs to existing owners.

title: Trigger gesture role
contract: Trigger: down starts clip; release is ignored. The source covers mouse, key and mapped MIDI-note gesture categories but supplies no dispatch/frame/note-off matching law.

title: Gate gesture role
contract: Gate: down starts and up stops. Exact quantized release, held/repeated MIDI pairing and cancellation remain U.

title: Toggle gesture role
contract: Toggle: down starts, up is ignored, next down stops. Multiple input-source arbitration and grid-boundary timing remain U.

title: Repeat gesture role
contract: Repeat retriggers while input remains held at clip quantization rate. None/Global edge behavior, first/last repeat and exact timing are not supplied.

title: Legato takeover role
contract: Launching Legato clip takes previous clip play position in same track, including with quantization off. Position units, wrap, unequal lengths and activation timing are unproven for target.

title: Legato media and RAM context
contract: Different-sample Legato jumps may cause dropouts because material was not preloaded; Clip RAM is documented as remedy. This is no zero-dropout, deadline or RAM/disk-load guarantee.

title: Quantization selector roles
contract: None disables launch onset correction; Global selects Control Bar quantization. Existing enum/grid/Trigger arithmetic retains its canonical owner and assumptions; Follow Action Global behavior is separately unresolved.

title: Launch velocity endpoints
contract: Velocity Amount0 gives no launch-note-velocity volume influence;100% says softest notes play silently. Softest valid launch velocity, interpolation, volume codec and non-MIDI launch response remain U.

title: Nudge role
contract: Nudge Backward/Forward jumps within playing clip by global quantization period. Source/file/loop bounds, None behavior and exact rounding remain U.

title: Nudge and scrub mapping affordances
contract: Nudge buttons can map to keys/MIDI; MIDI Map Mode reveals a scrub control between buttons for rotary-encoder continuous scrubbing. Mapping codec/takeover/relative interpretation remains outside this clause.

title: Offset relative to master clock
contract: Sub-bar quantization plus launch, nudge or scrub can offset clip playback relative to master clock. It does not specify a phase-offset equation or reset law.

title: Clip Follow groups
contract: Clip Follow Actions operate within successive occupied slots on one track; empty slots separate groups. Group definition here is clips, not a proven scene-group/empty-scene rule.

title: Scene Follow entry and local enable
contract: Follow Actions also have Scene View controls. Selected clip/scene local Follow button enables/disables them; source describes default disabled and Shift+Enter toggle. Actual constructor/focus/default-load state remains U.

title: Two action choices
contract: Each clip/scene exposes two Follow Action choices, A and B. Exact labels/images versus stored-code associations stay with scoped enum evidence and U control-context work.

title: Chance endpoints
contract: The source says A 100%/B 0% selects A every launch and0% suppresses its action. The later B 90%/~one-in-ten example leaves actual coupled-field changes unspecified; no general probability or normalization law follows.

title: Linked versus scene eligibility
contract: Linked/Unlinked is clip-only; Linked is described as default. Follow Time is exposed for both clips and scenes. No saved-field/default constructor parity is inferred.

title: Linked timing role
contract: Linked clip Follow occurs at clip end or after number of loops in Multiplier. Which region/end/loop accounting, nonlooped clips and clock rounding require target evidence.

title: Unlinked Time role
contract: Unlinked clip Follow uses duration in Follow Time; clip/scene Time is bars-beats-sixteenths from point where play starts. Default one bar and editor marker drag are documentary only; exact meter/offset codec remains U.

title: No-follow role
contract: The no-follow description says no Follow occurs; once clip is triggered with No Action, other selected Follow Action in that clip no longer gets a chance even if its Chance100%. Re-launch/re-enable/reset scope remains U.

title: Stop role
contract: Stop description stops clip after chosen Follow Time, overriding clip loop/region settings. Exact linked/unlinked preconditions, stop grid and note/tail cutoff are U.

title: Restart role
contract: Restart description restarts clip; start marker, Legato interaction, repeat counters and exact dispatch are not provided.

title: Previous role
contract: Previous description triggers clip immediately above current. Top-of-group wrap or escape across empty slot is not documented here.

title: Next and clip wrap
contract: Next description selects next clip down within group; last clip wraps to first. This clip statement is not applied automatically to scene-empty-group boundaries.

title: First role
contract: First description launches top clip in group. Exact empty-slot/reordering/concurrent group edits remain U.

title: Last role
contract: Last description launches bottom clip in group; self-target behavior when already last remains unresolved.

title: Any role
contract: Any description permits any clip in group; source gives no uniformity, independence, seed, repeat history or finite completion guarantee.

title: Nonconsecutive role
contract: Other-like description excludes consecutive same clip while current clip is not alone in group; singleton exception does not establish a specific fallback/retrigger law.

title: Jump selector role
contract: Jump exposes Jump Target slider for target clip slot or scene; drag or numeric entry adjusts target. UI numbering, stored jump fields, invalid/empty target behavior and action/image associations remain U.

title: Assigned Follow indicator
contract: Clips/scenes with assigned Follow Actions show striped launch buttons. Assigned versus enabled versus stored default fields is unresolved control context.

title: Global Follow enable
contract: Enable Follow Actions Globally governs all clip and scene Follow Actions. Source says grayed when Set contains none; which fields count as present versus assigned/enabled remains U.

title: Scene precedence role
contract: Clip Follow continues while scene Follow is created/scheduled; scene Follow takes precedence once triggered. Exact same-time priority, affected tracks and pending-request cancellation are U.

title: Cycle construction role
contract: Source describes Next cycles of clips or scenes and occasional alternatives using lower relative chances. This is no general scene-group/wrap or RNG law.

title: Create Follow Action Chain
contract: Clip context Create Follow Action Chain sets selected clips to cycle; selection need not be contiguous. Generated action codes, order, times, chances, enable flags and gap crossing are not specified.

title: Intro into loop composition
contract: Documented recipe splits nonlooped introduction from looping tail, places adjacent Session clips, sets first Next 100 and Time to first duration, second Loop on. Editing/transfer owners retain their own laws; exact derived timing remains U.

title: Temporary restart composition
contract: Single-clip Play Again 80/No Action 20 example restarts a portion and may later continue; the source eventual-language supplies no bounded-trial deadline or finite guarantee. A subsequent looping clip can have separate Follow configuration.

title: Legato Follow variation role
contract: Legato Follow can transfer beat-time position among similar clips with differing settings/envelopes/notes. This describes composed roles, not audible identity or complete automation/warp interaction.

title: GLOBAL-FOLLOW
contract: Global Follow quantization wording is unresolved between LC-B021 and LC-B047; no rule is selected.

title: CHANCE-COUPLING
contract: Chance A/B coupled editing, actual fields and probability/RNG law remain unknown.

title: ACTION-CONTEXT
contract: Image/label/action identity and target control contexts remain unknown beyond released stored enum vocabulary.

title: BOUNDARIES
contract: Region/group/target/time endpoints and ordering require exact target evidence.

title: CLIP-LIFECYCLE
contract: Clip-specific automation, storage/error/cancel/rate/teardown remain required unknowns.

title: SCENE-LIFECYCLE
contract: Scene-specific automation, storage/error/cancel/rate/teardown remain required unknowns.
